What's a good lap time around Suzuka
International Racing Course Grand Prix
in iRacing in the Porsche?
The top time set by a Track Titan user
is 2084. The fast drivers in the top 5%
achieve a lap time of around 2108.
Usually these are the drivers that can
aim for outright wins and podium
finishes in top tier races, often using
custom-made setups.
If you're new to racing or your goal is
simply to be better than the average,
you should aim for a time around 2134.
